name: Maine
description: Follow Maine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: ICE Agent Kills Person in Vehicle in Biddeford, Maine, State Officials Say
changes.summary: The fatal shooting in Biddeford, Maine, was the second in a week involving an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent firing into a vehicle.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump says the U.S. will collect tolls and impose blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, man killed by federal agents in Maine, states sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros merger.

changes.title: Officials Investigate Fatal ICE Shooting in Maine as Fallout Grows
changes.summary: There is a growing demand for answers after a fatal ICE-involved shooting in Maine. According to an ICE spokesperson, the shooting happened when agents tried to conduct a traffic stop and, they say, the vehicle tried to get away. That’s when ICE says an agent opened fire “fearing for public safety.” The incident, which.

changes.title: ICE halts most vehicle stops following deadly shootings, sources say
changes.summary: Neither of the victims of the ICE shootings in Maine or Texas were the target of enforcement operations, according to the Department of Homeland Security.

changes.title: Family of a man shot by agents responding to a 911 call seeks answers
changes.summary: A troubling pattern of federal agents fatally shooting civilians is developing, with deaths in Maine, Texas and Tennessee. The family of a man shot by agents told NPR they want answers.

changes.title: DHS says ICE officer who fatally shot driver in Maine was 'fearing for public safety'
changes.summary: A witness says he heard driver say, "I tried to stop.".

changes.title: Many questions remain after an ICE officer's fatal shooting of a Maine driver
changes.summary: Immigrant rights groups are demanding answers and planning more protests Tuesday over an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer's fatal shooting of a Maine driver.

changes.title: ICE needs to be ‘dismantled’: Senate candidate Dan Kleban after ICE-involved shooting in Maine
changes.summary: Dan Kleban (D-Maine) joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his run to replace Graham Platner in the Senate race. Kelban also reacts to the fatal ICE shooting in Maine.

changes.title: In the aftermath of deadly shootings, ICE pauses most traffic stops
changes.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement will pause non-urgent vehicle stops after two deadly shootings in less than a week, Maine U.S. Sen. Angus King's office tells NPR. (Image credit: Joseph Prezioso).

changes.title: Maine Democrats will square off in Senate debate Thursday
changes.summary: Democrats vying to replace former Maine Senate nominee Graham Platner on the ballot are set to battle on the debate stage Thursday night. News Center Maine confirmed the debate, which will be held at 7 p.m. EDT in Portland and include three former gubernatorial hopefuls — Troy Jackson , Shenna Bellows and Nirav Shah —.
